name: agentic-design-runtime
description: Create and revise deterministic, editable layered graphics through the local Agentic Design Runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Build editable graphics with local agents
interface.longDescription: Agentic Design Runtime gives Codex a complete local visual-design workflow: install and operate the pinned runtime, create or resume client workspaces, build graphics through typed transactions, render previews into chat, open Studio for human adjustments, and export approved PNG files.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable campaign graphic and show me the preview.
Revise my existing layered graphic and preserve its history.
Open Studio so I can adjust this design with you.
